summary: Frontend-only test of the round 2 UI changes: home About section, home footer without the address, the /free-counselling redesign and the /best-institute-in-pathankot redesign, at 1920px and 390px. Almost everything passes. One real bug: the Google Maps embed on the branch page is broken (Google returns 400 'Invalid pb parameter') and shows an empty grey box.

ui_bugs.issue: The iframe src https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=!1m18!1m12!1m3!1d3393.8!2d75.640!3d32.264... is rejected by Google ('Google Maps Platform rejected your request. Invalid request. Invalid pb parameter.'). The response is HTTP 400, which logs a console error, and the map area is an empty grey box. Suggested fix: src={`https://maps.google.com/maps?q=${branchInfo.geo.lat},${branchInfo.geo.lng}&z=16&output=embed`} or use a real pb string from Google Maps > Share > Embed.

issues: The 'Since 2017' badge (about-since-badge, absolute -bottom-8 left) covers the start of the image caption 'Live, hands-on lab sessions every day'. Only '...sions every day' is visible on desktop. Move the caption to the right (for example pl-40 or right-aligned) or move the badge.
The LandingHeader logo is very small (about 16px tall) and looks weak next to the large call button. Make it larger, around h-10.

The form card comes after the headline, the paragraph and 3 bullets, so it sits roughly 770px down and is not visible on first load. Think about placing the form directly after the headline on mobile, or adding a sticky 'Book free session' button.
Next/Image warning: /images/logo-blue.png has its width or height changed in CSS but not the other. Add style width:auto or height:auto.

about-learn-more-btn goes to /about and about-founder-btn goes to /founder

/about and /contact still show footer-head-office with the Jodhamal Colony address

/free-counselling: the header, call button (tel:+919646727676), hero, form card, credentials bar, how-it-works, coverage, partner logos, testimonials, FAQ (opens on click) and final CTA are all present. All 12 images load.
Counselling form: POST /api/counselling-leads returned 200 and the page redirected to /thank-you?source=counselling&name=TEST_Counsel

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use domcontentloaded plus a wait for a data-testid. Check the map iframe content using frame_locator. Do not change img attributes before hydration, because that causes false hydration warnings.
